verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents a live financial Model you can open to "check every number," forecasts of revenue, costs, and cash, actuals pulled from QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite/Rillet, and outputs that "print [their] lineage back to the source line." Together these point toward traceability from figures to source records. However, the evidence never names P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow statement views, and the lineage claim is short marketing copy that does not clearly describe interactive drill-down from any figure. Missing for 10: explicit P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement views; documented click-through drill-down from any figure to underlying transactions; independent or hands-on corroboration.
